section.content: 本发明涉及种微生物基因检测分析仪，包括A仓和B仓；A仓终端控制室控制旋涡混旋器、恒温水浴锅、高速冷冻离心机和第样品操作室；B仓第二样品操作室输入端与第样品操作室输出端连接；总控室控制第二样品操作室、分子杂交仪和电子荧光显微镜；终端软件分析系统分析电子荧光显微镜输出信息。本发明可实现取样、处理、杂交、观察、输出检测分析报告全自动化和智能化，本发明可定量、直观地监测微生物群落结构及空间分布，依据检测参数和多元知识数据，对目标微生物进行多级别、多层次、多方面综合检测，8～20小时即出检测分析报告。本发明具有很好的市场前景和应用前景。

The invention relates to a microbial gene detection analyzer, which comprises a cabin A and a cabin B; the A-bin terminal control chamber controls the vortex mixing and rotating device, the constant-temperature water bath, the high-speed freezing centrifuge and the first sample operation chamber; the input end of the second sample operation chamber of the chamber B is connected with the output end of the first sample operation chamber; the master control room controls the second sample operation room, the molecular hybridization instrument and the electron fluorescence microscope; and the terminal software analysis system analyzes the output information of the electron fluorescence microscope. The invention can realize full automation and intellectualization of sampling, processing, hybridizing, observing and outputting detection analysis reports, can quantitatively and visually monitor microbial community structure and spatial distribution, carries out multi-level, multi-level and multi-aspect comprehensive detection on target microorganisms according to detection parameters and multivariate knowledge data, and obtains the detection analysis reports within 8-20 hours. The invention has good market prospect and application prospect.

A kind of microorganism gene detection analysis instrumentTechnical field

The present invention relates to a kind of microorganism gene detection analysis instrument, specifically a kind of to examine for environmental microorganism gene Survey analyzer.

Background technology

Worldwide, the crude oil of subsurface deposit 30%～40% can only be produced with conventional oil recovery technique.How to improve Recovery ratio, produces more remaining oils from underground, the problem that always world many countries are constantly studied for many years.

It is the utilization after traditional methods such as heating power drive, chemical flooding, polymer flooding that microorganism improves oil recovery factor The beneficial activity of microorganism and metabolite are improving a comprehensive oil recovery technique of oil recovery factor.

Environmental problem has become the subject matter that China faces at this stage, and a little fields of here are required at microorganism participation Reason, then the separation identification to microorganism has the problem for becoming primary, and it is art technology to filter out high-quality and efficient microorganism The key that personnel explore.

Traditional microbiological oil recovery bacterial strain screening relies on reagent bottle detection, culture, by empirically determined solution, it is impossible to examine Actual microbe species are surveyed, Parallel testing result difference is big；And, objective microbe can only be carried out single-stage not, single level, list The analysis of aspect, time-consuming.

It is how quick, accurately, science and intuitively monitor and analysis environments microorganism becomes the focus of this area research.

The content of the invention

Present invention aim to address problem of the prior art, and propose one kind accurately can recognize, quick detection, science The microorganism gene detection analysis instrument of analysis microorganism situation.

For achieving the above object, the present invention takes technical scheme below：

A kind of microorganism gene detection analysis instrument, it is characterised in that the analyzer includes A storehouses and B storehouses；

Terminal control room control vortex DL device, thermostat water bath, high speed freezing centrifuge and the first sample in the A storehouses Operating room；The vortex DL device, thermostat water bath, high speed freezing centrifuge and the first sample operation room are respective defeated by which Enter end and output end is connected in turn；

The input of the second sample operation room in the B storehouses is connected with the output end of the first sample operation room；Master control Room controls the second sample operation room, Hybridization Oven and electronic fluorescent microscope；The second sample operation room, Hybridization Oven It is connected in turn by its respective input and output end with electronic fluorescent microscope；

Also include terminal software analysis system to analyze electronic fluorescent microscope output information.

A kind of above-mentioned microorganism gene detection analysis instrument, wherein the A storehouses also include the first observation ward, for monitoring State the processing procedure of vortex DL device, thermostat water bath, high speed freezing centrifuge and the first sample operation room.

A kind of above-mentioned microorganism gene detection analysis instrument, wherein between the vortex DL device and thermostat water bath, it is permanent The first sampling is equipped between warm water bath and high speed freezing centrifuge, between high speed freezing centrifuge and the first sample operation room System.

A kind of above-mentioned microorganism gene detection analysis instrument, wherein, the B storehouses also include the second observation ward, for monitoring Second sample operation room, Hybridization Oven and the microscopical processing procedure of electronic fluorescent.

A kind of above-mentioned microorganism gene detection analysis instrument, wherein, the second sample operation room and Hybridization Oven it Between, the second sampler is equipped between Hybridization Oven and electronic fluorescent microscope.

A kind of above-mentioned microorganism gene detection analysis instrument, wherein, the terminal software analysis system includes central control System, intelligent checking system, analysis system, data management system, networking management system and expert's prescription system.

A kind of microorganism gene detection analysis instrument purposes of the present invention is recommended as follows：

1st, return water is sterilized

2nd, polymer displacement of reservoir oil

3rd, microbe oil production

4th, water-oil separating

5th, microorganism wax removal

6th, microorganism de-plugging

Advantages of the present invention and beneficial effect are：

The present invention is applied to accurate identification, quick according to genetic fingerprints recognition principle and FISH principle Detection, scientific analysis microorganism situation.The present invention can accurately, quantitatively, intuitively monitor biological community structure and spatial distribution, According to detection parameter and polynary knowledge data, multi-level, multi-level, many-sided comprehensive analysis is carried out to objective microbe, detect, Quickly go out detection and analysis report.

The present invention can be detected for microorganism, especially for the microbial ecosystem of various environment, in the present invention Particular use of the present invention, but the not restriction to range of application of the present invention are introduced in content by taking petroleum microorganism as an example.
